tools.name: validate_xml
tools.description: Check XML well-formedness. Returns bounded errors and warnings with locations; uses one validation from the daily allowance.

tools.name: validate_xml_against_xsd
tools.description: Check XML against supplied XSD 1.0 or 1.1. Accepts one XSD or a local multi-file project with rootSchema; no network resolution. Returns bounded findings.

tools.name: validate_e_invoice
tools.description: Check invoice XML with a fixed EN16931, XRechnung, Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3), RO or HR package. KSeF is XSD-only; Factur-X checks XML only. No authority or network acceptance check.

tools.name: explain_validation_error
tools.description: Match an XML/XSD or invoice error code or message to an existing guide and explanation. Returns a general guide when no exact match exists.

tools.name: list_supported_standards
tools.description: List the six fixed invoice packages, versions, scope and limitations, plus generic XML and supplied-XSD support.

tools.name: search_xsdhub_guides
tools.description: Search XSDHub public XML and XSD guides. Returns source URLs and excerpts. Does not validate or upload XML.

tools.name: get_xsdhub_page
tools.description: Read one public XSDHub page as Markdown, with its canonical source URL. Accepts a public page slug, such as learn/xml-namespaces-explained, about or home.

tools.name: get_xsdhub_capabilities
tools.description: Read the supported browser tools, file limits, privacy boundaries and subscription test-mode status. No account or billing access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_xsdhub_guides, get_xsdhub_page · Private data: validate_xml_against_xsd, get_xsdhub_capabilities · Public sink: search_xsdhub_guides.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_xsdhub_guides, get_xsdhub_page · Private data: validate_xml_against_xsd, get_xsdhub_capabilities · Public sink: search_xsdhub_guides

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
